typescript-declarations.artifact: declaration files (.d.ts) emitted for the unit
typescript-declarations.digest: SHA-256 over sorted rows of path and SHA-256 of bytes of the declaration tree

rust-rmeta.digest: SHA-256 of the .rmeta file; a body edit changes it (spans and inlinable bodies are inside), so this is a conservative API digest

go-export-data.artifact: export data member __.PKGDEF of the compiled package archive
go-export-data.digest: SHA-256 of __.PKGDEF without its `build id` line (the `go tool compile -o` export archive of a pure-Go package has none)

python-api.artifact: API text extracted from the module sources (or the sibling .pyi stub)
python-api.digest: SHA-256 of the API text (see python.api)

dotnet-reference-assembly.artifact: reference assembly (metadata-only dll from /refout, deterministic build)
dotnet-reference-assembly.digest: SHA-256 of the reference assembly bytes

cpp-public-headers.artifact: the declared public header set of the unit
cpp-public-headers.digest: SHA-256 over sorted rows of path and SHA-256 of the comment- and whitespace-normalized text of the public headers

wit-world.artifact: canonical text of the WIT package and world
wit-world.digest: SHA-256 of the canonical text of the package: files merged, comments dropped, items of packages, interfaces and worlds sorted by text (order inside records, variants, enums, flags and signatures kept)

tex-aux.artifact: auxiliary reference files of the final pass (.aux, .toc)
tex-aux.digest: SHA-256 of the auxiliary file reduced to sorted newlabel and bibcite lines, ordered toc/lof/lot writes and bibstyle/bibdata
